exclusion_reason: No guest loop or recording exists to replay.
promotion_trigger: Promote when two replay hash-match at every declared checkpoint and the artifact privacy proof holds.
active_gate_evidence: The report command keeps consent recording minimized and off by default.
procedure: Record the fixture run and produce the reference artifact.
Replay twice and compare checkpoint hash.
Audit the artifact for embedded asset and personal data.
pass_criterion: The artifact is free of asset and personal data.
